product_one_liner.value: Wellinks helps health plans, providers and health systems deliver virtual COPD care through remote patient monitoring, pulmonary rehabilitation and ongoing care-management support.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and no public pricing or plans page was found.

value: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware
named_customers.notes: Supported by a provider testimonial describing actual use and an agreement to deliver Wellinks services to Highmark members.

employee_band.notes: Public profiles report approximately 27 employees, placing it in this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog covers pulmonary care, clinical research, company news and product marketing, rather than engineering-authored product-building posts.

public_docs.notes: A public knowledge base contains multiple app and device-support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists one role, Senior Data and BI Analyst, which does not qualify under the requested title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Product pages, support documentation, the blog and privacy policy describe predictive analytics and machine learning but do not disclose a specific AI model or model provider. No dedicated subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The footer displays a SOC 2 certification seal. The privacy notice claims HIPAA compliance; HIPAA is not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement describes the $10 million first close of its Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million Series B first close was announced August 4, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The only listed opening is Senior Data and BI Analyst; no SDR, BDR or account-executive role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying product or major-feature launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The recent announcements concern funding and leadership; product-related entries predate the window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: An August 31, 2026 announcement identifies Stephanie Solich as the new VP of Customer Success in an expanded management team; it also reports internal VP promotions.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting names analytics and data tools but no CRM, sales or marketing system.
